out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hand washing sink at the back of the house was not temping correctly. The water was only temping at 85F, it needs to be at least 100F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE WATER AT THE HANDWASHING SINKS NEEDS TO BE 100F OR HIGHER. PIC SAID THEY WILL TALK TO MAINTENANCE TO CORRECT THE ISSUE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2DR prep top (2) did not have a thermometer in the unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS ASKED PIC TO MAKE SURE THAT ALL UNITS HAVE THERMOMETERS IN THEM.
